mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 70 degrees at Verona Community Park, with a waning crescent moon phase in the sky.

In city news, the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new guide replaces the old plan and focuses on housing, sustainability, and supporting our local businesses to ensure Verona remains a great place to live and work for the next ten years.

We have a busy day in Verona today. You can catch live music at Paddy Macs, grab fresh goods at the Downtown Farmers Market in Hometown Junction Park, join the trivia fun at The Bogey Factory, or enjoy Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for ART House 360 events starting tomorrow.

In a report from the Verona Police Department, on September 28, officers responded to a collision involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly. The individual was cited for reckless driving and operating without a license.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to head over to get your treat before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
